task:
Find 5 RECENT job listings for Product Manager roles in India.

Use https://www.naukri.com/product-manager-jobs-in-india — open it with interactive=true, because job boards serve a block page to a headless browser. Indeed and LinkedIn will show a bot challenge; do not waste steps on them.

The listings are NOT in a table — they are cards. Use action.browser_extract_records to read them. If it returns nothing the first time, scroll down and try again; these pages draw their results after the first paint.

For each of the 5 listings give me: job title, company name, location, experience required, and the listing URL if one is shown.

Report only what you actually read off the page. If a field is not shown, write 'not shown' rather than guessing. Do not invent listings or URLs.
